title: The Asking Heron
statement: Long ago a heron waded into the river of stars and, instead of fishing, asked the river where it was going; the river, delighted that anyone had wondered, poured out every story it carried, and each answer left a star caught on her feathers. She stands there still, one foot raised, her neck bent into a question mark, and on clear nights her stars brighten one by one as if she has just asked something new.
